adversarial_findings.finding: failed_jobs table grows unbounded — no janitor cron
adversarial_findings.evidence: grep 'queue:prune-failed|queue:flush-failed|failed_jobs' app/Console/Kernel.php → 0 matches. Outbox has prune (90d, line 119), webhook has prune (180d, line 135), audit/Z-reports have retention, but failed_jobs table has zero scheduled cleanup. Over weeks/months in production the table grows linearly with every job-final-failure (contract_violation short-circuit at DispatchDomainEventsJob:184 lands every malformed payload here).
adversarial_findings.fix: Add to app/Console/Kernel.php: $schedule->command('queue:prune-failed', ['--hours=336'])->dailyAt('04:30')->name('queue-prune-failed')->onOneServer()->withoutOverlapping(); — 14d retention matches webhook/outbox janitor cadence and stays well past Horizon recent_failed window (10080 min = 7d).

adversarial_findings.finding: Queue worker crash mid-job — retry within 90s lease window
adversarial_findings.evidence: queue.php:41 database/redis 'retry_after' = 90s default (Laravel). DispatchDomainEventsJob $tries=6 + $backoff=[1,5,15,60,300] = up to 6.4min total retry window per claim. Combined with Phase 1 lockForUpdate + dispatched_at guard (DispatchDomainEventsJob:65-86), a crashed worker leaves the row claimed (dispatched_at set) BUT Phase 3b at :161-166 forceFills dispatched_at=null on exception — so an OOM/SIGKILL between :86 (commit) and :116 (broadcast) would leave a 'silent gap' (event marked dispatched, no broadcast). Mitigated by ws:heartbeat cache + SyncOverview probeHealth heuristic (90s window).
adversarial_findings.fix: None required for V1 LOCAL. Phase E cloud-prep should consider a 'dispatched_at older than retry_after AND no broadcast log' rescue lane.

adversarial_findings.finding: Job timeout 120s + slow Stripe API → leftover in flight
adversarial_findings.evidence: E2ESoakCommand:152 recommends timeout=120s. Horizon supervisor-high timeout=90s. DispatchDomainEventsJob itself does NOT call Stripe — Stripe sits in PaymentService (sync path). Side-effect job SendOrderMail/Sms/Push has no Stripe call. No in-flight risk observed on outbox lane.

adversarial_findings.finding: 100 concurrent kiosk submits + 5 cashiers + 3 chefs → DB pool exhaust
adversarial_findings.evidence: MySQL default max_connections=151. Each HTTP request = 1 PDO connection (PHP-FPM per-request). Worst-case 100+5+3=108 + 8 high workers + 4 default workers + 1 cron = ~121 connections, under 151 default. innodb_lock_wait_timeout=5s caps worst-case stall under hot-row contention (fiscal_seq alloc, OrderStateMachine lockForUpdate). E2ESoakCommand:86 db-pool-pct-ceiling=80% (≈120 connections) aligns.
adversarial_findings.fix: V1 LOCAL safe. Cloud-prep (multi-instance ALB): tune max_connections + add proxysql/PgBouncer-equivalent for MySQL once worker count exceeds single-host capacity.

verdict_rationale: Queue lane discipline is clean (SSOT in job constructor, no drift across 14 listeners + 3 commands). Transaction scope is clean (broadcasts all outside tx, OrderCreated uses afterCommit trait). NF525-critical Cache::lock sites have triple defense (Cache::lock + DB::transaction + lockForUpdate + DB UNIQUE). HOWEVER: (1) Two P1 N+1 sites on KDS hot path (KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService:70 + KdsSyncService:96 missing nested orderItems.orderItem) accumulate cost at poll cadence 5-60s — 50 orders × ~30 polls/min = up to 1500 avoidable queries/min/branch in worst case; (2) failed_jobs table grows unbounded — operational risk under chronic outbox failures. Neither blocks V1 ship for single-box Le Cayenne, but both should be backlog P1 before production scale-out.
cloud_prep_concerns: ProxySQL or equivalent for connection pooling at scale
